card.name: The word all in "of all ages"
card.fires_on: The word "all" right after "patients of" or "people of", just before "ages". It is strongest in antidepressant suicidality warnings.

modes.label: Antidepressant warning
modes.description: "all" after "Patients of" in the boxed warning about starting antidepressant therapy.
modes.example: Patients of<< all>> ages who are started on antidepressant therapy

modes.label: General web text
modes.description: "all" after a group noun and "of" in general text about people of every age.
modes.example: ensuring that Pennsylvanians of<< all>> ages are prepared to manage money, credit

card.writes: It promotes words meaning "regardless" or "no matter" (such as 无论 and 不论), which suggests the pole adds an "irrespective of age" idea.
card.plain: It marks the word "all" in the phrase "of all ages", meaning the statement applies to everyone whatever their age.
